description: Read-only diagnostic for local blue-green self-deployment. Returns the local router status snapshot plus plugin-local swap state, including active color, registered colors and ports, drain entries, this process color, this process instance id, and whether a swap is in progress. No state is mutated.
embedding_description: Read local blue-green router status and swap state. Use to inspect active_color, registered colors, bridge ports, drain entries, swap_in_progress, self_color, and self_instance_id before or during local restart_with_manifest operations. Read-only and safe.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Router status snapshot plus swap_in_progress, self_color, and self_instance_id.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Lead with active color and registered colors. Include drain entries if present and call out swap_in_progress=true during active cutover.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Read local blue-green router and plugin-local swap state.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: router_unavailable means the local router socket is missing or unreachable. malformed_status means the router replied with an unexpected payload.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Verify the router process and socket under the runtime directory. If the router is down, restart through the local launch workflow rather than forcing a swap.
